accounts.body: Users must provide truthful information, including their DNI and, for renters, a valid driver's license. Veygo may suspend accounts with false information to protect the community.
accounts.title: 2. Accounts and identity verification

bookings.body: A booking is a request that the owner must confirm. Pending or confirmed bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before the rental starts. The platform prevents overlapping bookings for the same vehicle.
bookings.title: 3. Bookings and cancellations

data.body: Personal data is used only to operate the service, in accordance with Peruvian Law No. 29733 on Personal Data Protection. Veygo does not sell personal data and users may request its deletion at any time.
data.title: 5. Personal data

liability.body: Veygo is developed following the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the CIP Code of Ethics, prioritizing the safety, privacy and interests of its users. This version is an academic prototype.
liability.title: 6. Professional responsibility

owners.body: Owners must publish accurate information about the condition, documents, insurance and price of their vehicles and keep their availability up to date.
owners.title: 4. Owner responsibilities

scope.body: Veygo, a product of the startup Zyntra, is a digital platform that connects vehicle owners with people who want to rent a vehicle in Lima. Veygo is not the owner of the vehicles and acts as an intermediary.
scope.title: 1. About Veygo
